Generate a verbatim `filters = list(...)` argument value

Source: R/recipe.R
dot-codegen_filter_list.Rd

Generate a verbatim `filters = list(...)` argument value

Usage

.codegen_filter_list(filters)

Arguments

filters

List of omop_filter/omop_filter_group objects.

Value

A .codegen_raw() string, or NULL when empty (so .codegen_call() drops the argument).
